title: Resource status (<resource_status_dir>/<name>/status.json)
description: Written by lychee-ops' resources_reconcile role (tasks/write_status.yml). A declaration the validator rejects is written with image, state and action all ''.

image.description: The declared image, tagless for a site awaiting its first image, or '' for a rejected declaration.

target_tag.description: The tag the declaration pins, or the sentinel 'none' when its image has no tag.

installed_tag.description: The last tag successfully applied, or 'none' (never applied, or after a completed down).

available_tag.description: The newest tag the registry publishes, or '' when unknown. '' and not 'none', unlike the two tags above.

installed_commit.description: Always the literal 'none' today: a resource is versioned by tag.
